title: Relax.
note: Your gentle reminder whenever I feel anxious. Your one word makes everything feel lighter.

title: AI
note: I call you 'AI' because you’re unbelievably good at coding — honestly, smarter than any machine.

title: Innocence
note: Despite being brilliant, you’re still so shy and innocent — and that’s what makes you my little baby.

title: Double-meaning jokes
note: They often fly over your head, and somehow that makes me laugh even more.

title: Late-night talks
note: Our conversations stretch into the night, becoming one of the most comforting parts of my day.

title: Encouragement
note: Whenever I call myself dumb, you remind me that I’m brave and never let me put myself down.

title: Safe place
note: Whenever I feel low, I come to you. You always listen and somehow make everything feel better.

title: Chess draw
note: You could have won easily, but you let the game end in a draw just so I wouldn’t lose.

title: Little apologies
note: You say sorry for even the smallest things — sometimes even when it’s actually my fault. That soft heart of yours is something I adore.

title: A little possessive
note: You’re a little possessive and sometimes act like you don’t want to share me with anyone. It’s your cute way of saying, 'I want you all to myself.'

title: Cute aggression
note: You somehow manage to scold me when I make silly mistakes, and even your angry little lectures end up being cute to me.
